accepted_scientific_checks: The new source concerns engineered yeast GAP1 copy-number reporting, distinct from the already assessed E. coli repair-focus source and from native SBW25 W/A/M routes.
The 7.1% criterion is a population apparent-CNV threshold from control mean plus one standard deviation; it is not an event-level error probability, confidence bound or mutation birth time.

Selected late-clone DNA validation is distinct from the regrown-clone fluorescence reference used for sorting-purity correction; neither supplies an event-level false-negative or inherited-origin truth denominator.
The 29 sequencing and 28 competitive-fitness denominators remain distinct without asserting disjoint cohorts; eight nonsignificant fitness differences are not a neutrality equivalence result.

Barcodes can be shared by multiple founders, complex CNVs can comprise several events, and ancestral/new interpretations remain probabilistic; label counts do not become independently measured mutation births.
Pairwise clone fitness and aggregate trajectory expansion do not supply independently observed single-new-mutant establishment or separate native supply and establishment.
Original population, barcode-culture, detailed barcode-sequencing, cell, clone and event units remain distinct; 267/270 and 265/270 timing discrepancies are preserved.
Reporter controls supply limited contextual evidence without universal reporter invariance, complete CNV-spectrum coverage or transport to SBW25.
The two OSF folder levels authenticate selected metadata only; project license metadata and file access limits do not license or authenticate unretrieved deposit contents.
The falsifiable future-admission predicates are conditional review requirements, not source-author claims, a selected protocol or a commissioned experiment.
